name: Conditional same-policy Deny narrows a rule edge (may-block, not blocked)
note: Allow iam:PutUserPolicy with an unconditional grant, but a same-policy Deny of the same action carries a Condition (MFA absent). A conditional Deny may not fire, so it must NOT be reported as a hard block; graph.js downgrades the can-modify(policy:self) edge to context-required instead of blocked-by-deny. The graph is built from the pre-correlation finding set, so the DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN self-modify edge is unaffected by IAM-705; at the table level iam:PutUserPolicy trips the specific PUT-INLINE-POLICY primitive and the generic DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN is folded into it (IAM-705 dedup), so the authoritative row is PUT-INLINE-POLICY.
